The bulk is reflection symmetric and UM-2 has no oriented tip operator (the tip Z portal of the one-generation version, whose oriented part let the odd Psi_A states decay, is dropped), so the fold parity is exact in both halves and the lowest odd states of Psi_A and Psi_B are both stable (their chiral tip charges would be 1.579 times that of the Psi_A fold band, and 0 for Psi_B)
